content: MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries: after a mission, per-location armor/structure damage and destroyed components carry back to the hangar. Repairs are work orders with day-costs (about 0.05 days per armor point by default, 1-2 weeks typical); cancelling a work order reverts all progress (all-or-nothing). Player advances time explicitly via a timeline until the next event. Multi-mission contracts advance time by each mission's duration. Community consensus from Steam discussions and Nexus mods.
